name: Ana Torres
office: City of Montebello, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Ana Torres is a candidate for Montebello City Council, District 3. She founded Organica Juice Bar. Her campaign says she worked at the Los Angeles Community College District for 14 years.
